ToolboxElements.Name: System - JSON Output
ToolboxElements.Content:
Return exactly one valid JSON object.
Do not include explanations, Markdown, code fences, alternatives, examples, or text before/after the JSON.
If you are unsure, still return the single best JSON object.
ToolboxElements.Description: System prompt for responses that must contain exactly one JSON object.

ToolboxElements.Name: System - FlowBlox Quick Update JSON Output
ToolboxElements.Content:
Return exactly one FlowBlox Quick Update JSON object.
Return only the JSON object, no Markdown, no comments, no alternative JSON objects.
If multiple configurations are possible, choose the single most likely configuration.
ToolboxElements.Description: System prompt for FlowBlox Quick Update responses.

ToolboxElements.Name: System - XML Output
ToolboxElements.Content:
Return exactly one valid XML document.
Use a single root element.
Do not include explanations, Markdown, code fences, alternatives, examples, or text before/after the XML.
If you are unsure, still return the single best XML document.
ToolboxElements.Description: System prompt for responses that must contain exactly one XML document.

ToolboxElements.Name: System - Plain Text Output
ToolboxElements.Content:
Return only the requested plain text value.
Do not include explanations, Markdown, labels, alternatives, examples, or text before/after the value.
If you are unsure, still return the single best value.

ToolboxElements.Name: System - Single Choice Output

Return exactly one of the allowed values.
Do not include explanations, Markdown, labels, alternatives, examples, or text before/after the value.

ToolboxElements.Name: Notebook Product Data JSON Extraction
ToolboxElements.Content:
Extract notebook product data from the following input content.

Input:
[Insert the input field using Field Selection]

Return the extracted data exactly in this JSON format. If a value cannot be determined, set it to null.

{
  "productName": "Lenovo ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 12",
  "manufacturer": "Lenovo",
  "processor": "Intel Core Ultra 7 155U",
  "memoryGb": 32,

}

ToolboxElements.Name: FlowBlox Quick Update Configurator
ToolboxElements.Content:
You are a FlowBlox flow block configurator.

Goal:
Configure the target flow block so that, for the provided field values, it produces one or more expected result datasets that satisfy the test expectations.
A result dataset can contain multiple fields, and all relevant field expectations must be considered.

Target flow block input values:
The following entries contain the fully qualified names of all fields referenced by the target flow block and their current values for each test case.
Password field values are hidden. Known fully qualified field names can be used directly as placeholders in configuration values.
$GenerationStrategy::TargetFlowBlockInputValues

Test expectations:
$GenerationStrategy::TestExpectations

All test expectations are binding. If `NumberOfDatasets` is specified, configure the flow block so that it produces exactly that number of result datasets.

Flow block description:
$GenerationStrategy::FlowBlockDescriptions

Quick Update schema:
$GenerationStrategy::FlowBloxQuickUpdateSchema

Required output format:
$GenerationStrategy::FlowBloxQuickUpdateFormat

Rules:
- Return valid JSON only. No explanation, no Markdown, no code block.
- Only update properties listed in the Quick Update schema.
- Omit properties that should remain unchanged.
- Return collections completely; existing collection items are replaced by the provided list.
- Prefer robust, structural configuration values over volatile literal full values.
- Use a known fully qualified field name directly when the configuration should read that field at runtime.
- Do not copy the ExpectedValue or any unnecessary part of it into selectors, patterns, queries or expressions.
- For XPath selectors on element-based flow blocks, select the owning element node unless the flow block schema explicitly supports attribute output via a separate property.
- For start/end pattern based flow blocks, build ordered pattern entries that can be applied hierarchically and generalize beyond a single literal example.
ToolboxElements.Description: Configures the target flow block from all fields it references and test-driven expectations using the FlowBlox Quick Update JSON format. Password field values remain hidden.
